name: LA Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: LA Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate business in Japan. It operates through DX New Construction Real Estate Business; DX Regeneration Real Estate Business; DX Real Estate Value Improvement Project; Real Estate Leasing; and Others segment.
